question: Should autonomous jobs be permitted to close well-supported issue-only duplicate clusters before a fix PR exists, while retaining the current security and pull-request-cluster safeguards?
rationale: This is a repository cleanup-policy boundary rather than a mechanical correctness question; the patch can be technically correct while maintainers reasonably choose a stricter close policy.

options.title: Approve the bounded issue-only exception
options.body: Allow autonomous duplicate closure for issue-only non-security clusters, preserving the patch's security and pull-request safeguards.

options.title: Keep fix-first for every autonomous cluster
options.body: Retain the existing requirement that an autonomous close follows a fix or merge candidate even for issue-only duplicates.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded issue-only exception
recommendation.body: Allow autonomous duplicate closure for issue-only non-security clusters, preserving the patch's security and pull-request safeguards.
